requirements.name: MCAL-SHALL-001
shall_statements: MCAL SHALL 提供标准 AUTOSAR API (如 Adc_Init, Can_Write)

requirements.name: MCAL-SHALL-002
shall_statements: 所有 MCAL 模块 SHALL 支持同步和中断两种操作模式

requirements.name: MCAL-SHALL-003
shall_statements: MCAL SHALL 使用 MISRA C:2023 合规编码风格

requirements.name: ECUAL-SHALL-001
shall_statements: ECUAL SHALL 使用 MCAL API, 不直接操作硬件寄存器

requirements.name: ECUAL-SHALL-002
shall_statements: 看门狗管理器 SHALL 在超时前刷新

requirements.name: SVC-SHALL-001
shall_statements: OS SHALL 提供符合 OSEK/AUTOSAR OS 的调度服务

requirements.name: SVC-SHALL-002
shall_statements: 通信栈 (CAN/以太网) SHALL 实现 PDU 路由

requirements.name: SVC-SHALL-003
shall_statements: 诊断事件管理器 (Dem) SHALL 记录并上报 DTC

requirements.name: NFR-SHALL-001
shall_statements: 代码 MISRA C:2023 合规

requirements.name: NFR-SHALL-002
shall_statements: 单元测试行覆盖率

requirements.name: NFR-SHALL-003
shall_statements: 条件覆盖率

requirements.name: NFR-SHALL-004
shall_statements: 静态分析 (cppcheck)

requirements.name: 7MISRA-SHALL-13
shall_statements: SHALL 使用 MISRA C:2023 `safety` 配置

requirements.name: DCMDIAGN-SHALL-1
shall_statements: SHALL support UDS service IDs 0x10, 0x11, 0x14, 0x19, 0x22, 0x2E, 0x31, 0x34, 0x36, 0x37 as specified in ISO 14229-1.

requirements.name: DCMDIAGN-SHALL-2
shall_statements: SHALL support a maximum of 4 concurrent diagnostic sessions.

requirements.name: DCMDIAGN-SHALL-3
shall_statements: SHALL enforce P2 timeout of 50ms for diagnostic responses.

requirements.name: DCMDIAGN-SHALL-4
shall_statements: SHALL enforce P2\* timeout of 500ms for diagnostic responses.

requirements.name: DEMDIAGN-SHALL-5
shall_statements: SHALL support storage of up to 256 diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs).

requirements.name: DEMDIAGN-SHALL-6
shall_statements: SHALL support 3 event priority levels: Low, Medium, High.

requirements.name: DEMDIAGN-SHALL-7
shall_statements: SHALL store diagnostic events with primary and secondary (freeze frame) data.

requirements.name: DEMDIAGN-SHALL-8
shall_statements: SHALL provide a configurable aging counter with default 40 cycles.

requirements.name: COM-SHALL-9
shall_statements: SHALL support a configurable signal count with default of 1024 signals.

requirements.name: COM-SHALL-10
shall_statements: SHALL support signal group communication.

requirements.name: COM-SHALL-11
shall_statements: SHALL support I-PDU send and receive directions.

requirements.name: COM-SHALL-12
shall_statements: SHALL support deadline monitoring for signal transmission.

requirements.name: PDUR-SHALL-13
shall_statements: SHALL maintain a static routing table generated at build time.

requirements.name: PDUR-SHALL-14
shall_statements: SHALL support a maximum of 512 routing paths.

requirements.name: PDUR-SHALL-15
shall_statements: SHALL support gateway routing between CAN ↔ LIN and CAN ↔ Ethernet.

requirements.name: NVM-SHALL-16
shall_statements: SHALL support native, redundant, and dataset NVM block management.

requirements.name: NVM-SHALL-17
shall_statements: SHALL use CRC-32 for write verification.

requirements.name: NVM-SHALL-18
shall_statements: SHALL support block sizes from 1 to 65536 bytes.

requirements.name: NVM-SHALL-19
shall_statements: SHALL support a maximum of 512 NVM blocks.

requirements.name: NVM-SHALL-20
shall_statements: SHALL support 4 job priority levels.

requirements.name: ECUM-SHALL-21
shall_statements: SHALL support startup phases STARTUP_ONE and STARTUP_TWO.

requirements.name: ECUM-SHALL-22
shall_statements: SHALL support shutdown targets OFF, RESET, and SLEEP.

requirements.name: ECUM-SHALL-23
shall_statements: SHALL support wakeup sources including CAN, LIN, Ethernet, Pin, and Timer.

requirements.name: OSAUTOSA-SHALL-24
shall_statements: SHALL provide fixed cyclic schedule tables.

requirements.name: OSAUTOSA-SHALL-25
shall_statements: SHALL support BCC2 and ECC2 task conformance classes.

requirements.name: OSAUTOSA-SHALL-26
shall_statements: SHALL support a maximum of 64 tasks.

requirements.name: OSAUTOSA-SHALL-27
shall_statements: SHALL support a maximum of 32 alarms.

requirements.name: OSAUTOSA-SHALL-28
shall_statements: SHALL implement the priority ceiling protocol for resource management.

requirements.name: CANIFCAN-SHALL-1
shall_statements: SHALL support a maximum of 2 CAN controllers (CAN0, CAN1).

requirements.name: CANIFCAN-SHALL-2
shall_statements: SHALL support up to 512 PDU IDs.

requirements.name: CANIFCAN-SHALL-3
shall_statements: SHALL support transmit and receive PDU modes.

requirements.name: CANIFCAN-SHALL-4
shall_statements: SHALL support sleep and wakeup functionality.

requirements.name: CANTPCAN-SHALL-5
shall_statements: SHALL implement the ISO 15765-2 CAN transport protocol.

requirements.name: CANTPCAN-SHALL-6
shall_statements: SHALL support message segmentation up to 4095 bytes per message.

requirements.name: CANTPCAN-SHALL-7
shall_statements: SHALL support Continuous and Wait flow control modes.

requirements.name: CANTPCAN-SHALL-8
shall_statements: SHALL support Physical and Functional addressing.

requirements.name: CANNMCAN-SHALL-9
shall_statements: SHALL implement AUTOSAR CAN Network Management protocol.

requirements.name: CANNMCAN-SHALL-10
shall_statements: SHALL support a configurable 8-bit node ID.

requirements.name: CANNMCAN-SHALL-11
shall_statements: SHALL support configurable message cycle time with default of 100ms.

requirements.name: CANNMCAN-SHALL-12
shall_statements: SHALL support configurable repeat message timer with default of 1000ms.

requirements.name: CANNMCAN-SHALL-13
shall_statements: SHALL support bus synchronization.

requirements.name: SOADSOCK-SHALL-14
shall_statements: SHALL support a maximum of 32 sockets.

requirements.name: SOADSOCK-SHALL-15
shall_statements: SHALL support TCP and UDP protocols.

requirements.name: SOADSOCK-SHALL-16
shall_statements: SHALL support Server and Client connection types.

requirements.name: SOADSOCK-SHALL-17
shall_statements: SHALL support SOME/IP protocol communication.

requirements.name: SOMEIPSD-SHALL-18
shall_statements: SHALL support an offer cycle of 1000ms for service discovery.

requirements.name: SOMEIPSD-SHALL-19
shall_statements: SHALL support a request cycle of 2000ms for service discovery.

requirements.name: SOMEIPSD-SHALL-20
shall_statements: SHALL support TTL multiplier of 3 for service entries.

requirements.name: DLT-SHALL-21
shall_statements: SHALL support log levels including Fatal, Error, Warn, Info, Debug, and Verbose.

requirements.name: DLT-SHALL-22
shall_statements: SHALL support TCP and Serial transport for DLT messages.

requirements.name: DLT-SHALL-23
shall_statements: SHALL support Application ID filtering.

requirements.name: XCP-SHALL-24
shall_statements: SHALL support CAN and Ethernet transport layers for XCP.

requirements.name: XCP-SHALL-25
shall_statements: SHALL implement XCP protocol version 1.5.

requirements.name: XCP-SHALL-26
shall_statements: SHALL support XCP slave functionality.

requirements.name: XCP-SHALL-27
shall_statements: SHALL support calibration page switching.

requirements.name: XCP-SHALL-28
shall_statements: SHALL support up to 8 DAQ lists.

requirements.name: ADCDRIVE-SHALL-1
shall_statements: SHALL support 10-bit and 12-bit configurable ADC resolution.

requirements.name: ADCDRIVE-SHALL-2
shall_statements: SHALL support Single, Continuous, and Scan conversion modes.

requirements.name: ADCDRIVE-SHALL-3
shall_statements: SHALL support up to 16 channels per ADC instance.

requirements.name: ADCDRIVE-SHALL-4
shall_statements: SHALL support left and right result alignment.

requirements.name: ADCDRIVE-SHALL-5
shall_statements: SHALL support interrupt-based and polling notification modes.

requirements.name: CANDRIVE-SHALL-6
shall_statements: SHALL support Classical CAN (2.0B) and CAN FD protocols.

requirements.name: CANDRIVE-SHALL-7
shall_statements: SHALL support bit rates from 125kbps to 1Mbps for CAN and up to 8Mbps for CAN FD.

requirements.name: CANDRIVE-SHALL-8
shall_statements: SHALL provide 64 mailboxes for CAN message buffering.

requirements.name: CANDRIVE-SHALL-9
shall_statements: SHALL support FIFO mode for CAN message reception.

requirements.name: CANDRIVE-SHALL-10
shall_statements: SHALL support loopback mode for self-test.

requirements.name: CANDRIVE-SHALL-11
shall_statements: SHALL provide automatic bus-off recovery conforming to AUTOSAR specification.

requirements.name: CRYPTODR-SHALL-12
shall_statements: SHALL support AES-128/256 encryption in ECB, CBC, and CTR modes.

requirements.name: CRYPTODR-SHALL-13
shall_statements: SHALL support SHA-256 hashing.

requirements.name: CRYPTODR-SHALL-14
shall_statements: SHALL support ECC P-256 elliptic curve cryptography.

requirements.name: CRYPTODR-SHALL-15
shall_statements: SHALL accelerate cryptographic operations using S32K312 HSM.

requirements.name: CRYPTODR-SHALL-16
shall_statements: SHALL store cryptographic keys in HSM secure NVM.

requirements.name: CRYPTODR-SHALL-17
shall_statements: SHALL provide integrated hardware TRNG.

requirements.name: CRYPTODR-SHALL-18
shall_statements: SHALL provide MbedTLS fallback for SIL simulation.

requirements.name: DIODRIVE-SHALL-19
shall_statements: SHALL support 8 ports with 32 pins each for digital I/O.

requirements.name: DIODRIVE-SHALL-20
shall_statements: SHALL support configurable pin direction per pin.

requirements.name: DIODRIVE-SHALL-21
shall_statements: SHALL support HIGH and LEVEL output levels.

requirements.name: DIODRIVE-SHALL-22
shall_statements: SHALL support edge-triggered interrupt on rising, falling, and both edges.

requirements.name: PORTDRIV-SHALL-23
shall_statements: SHALL support pin mux configuration for approximately 100 pins.

requirements.name: PORTDRIV-SHALL-24
shall_statements: SHALL support ALT0 through ALT7 mux modes.

requirements.name: PORTDRIV-SHALL-25
shall_statements: SHALL support configurable pad properties including pull-up, pull-down, slew rate, and drive strength.

requirements.name: GPTDRIVE-SHALL-26
shall_statements: SHALL provide 8 hardware timer channels.

requirements.name: GPTDRIVE-SHALL-27
shall_statements: SHALL provide 32-bit timer resolution.

requirements.name: GPTDRIVE-SHALL-28
shall_statements: SHALL support prescaler values from 1 to 65536.

requirements.name: GPTDRIVE-SHALL-29
shall_statements: SHALL support one-shot and continuous timer modes.

requirements.name: ICUDRIVE-SHALL-30
shall_statements: SHALL support up to 8 input capture channels.

requirements.name: ICUDRIVE-SHALL-31
shall_statements: SHALL support signal period, duty cycle, and pulse width measurement.

requirements.name: ICUDRIVE-SHALL-32
shall_statements: SHALL support rising, falling, and both edge detection.

requirements.name: MCUDRIVE-SHALL-33
shall_statements: SHALL support clock sources SOSC, SIRC, FIRC, PLL, and SPLL.

requirements.name: MCUDRIVE-SHALL-34
shall_statements: SHALL support 4 RAM section banks.

requirements.name: MCUDRIVE-SHALL-35
shall_statements: SHALL support RUN, SLEEP, STOP, and STANDBY power modes.

requirements.name: MCUDRIVE-SHALL-36
shall_statements: SHALL support POR, WDG, SW, and External reset sources.

requirements.name: WDGDRIVE-SHALL-37
shall_statements: SHALL provide configurable watchdog timeout from milliseconds to seconds.

requirements.name: WDGDRIVE-SHALL-38
shall_statements: SHALL support window mode watchdog operation.

requirements.name: WDGDRIVE-SHALL-39
shall_statements: SHALL support test mode for diagnostic testing.

requirements.name: DCM-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL support ISO 14229-1 UDS diagnostic services

requirements.name: DCM-SHALL-02
shall_statements: SHALL support session management (default, programming, extended)

requirements.name: DEM-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL support DTC storage and retrieval

requirements.name: DET-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL report development errors with module ID and error code

requirements.name: DOIP-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL support DoIP vehicle discovery

requirements.name: COM-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL support signal-based I-PDU communication

requirements.name: PDUR-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL route I-PDUs between COM and transport layers

requirements.name: CANSM-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL manage CAN network state machine

requirements.name: LIN-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL support LIN master/slave communication

requirements.name: NVM-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL support NV block read/write with redundancy

requirements.name: FEE-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL emulate EEPROM over flash with wear leveling

requirements.name: MEMIF-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL abstract NvM from Fee/EEP driver

requirements.name: ECUM-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL manage ECU startup/shutdown/wakeup sequences

requirements.name: BSWM-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL implement mode-based BSW scheduling

requirements.name: WDGM-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL monitor alive and deadline supervision

requirements.name: OS-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL provide AUTOSAR OS SC4 compliant scheduling

requirements.name: E2E-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL protect safety-critical signals with CRC and sequence counter

requirements.name: CSM-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL provide cryptographic service management

requirements.name: KEYM-SHALL-01
shall_statements: SHALL manage cryptographic keys
